speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing agitation and have a yellowish tint to your skin and eyes; have you noticed any pain in your upper right abdomen or changes in your urine color recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis B with acute liver failure.

Based on your history of high-risk sexual behavior, recent drug use, and the rapid onset of jaundice with agitation, I suspect an acute viral infection. Have you had any recent fever, nausea, or dark urine?
